quest.title: Fresh Flora
quest.description: To help Flora ascertain the effectiveness of putting plants in cold storage, you must head to Dragonspine once again to retrieve the flowers buried in the snow...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Here, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Do you still remember the flowers that I asked you to store on Dragonspine?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: It's been a day since then, and I'd like to see the results of our cold storage experiment.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Could you help me go up the mountain and bring those flowers back?

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: I'm counting on you, then. I'll be waiting here, so do come back soon.

choices.text: Where did I put them, again?

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: You forgot? You put them <color=#00E1FFFF>beside a Statue of The Seven</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>by a body of water in the mountains</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>near a cavern</color>.

response.speaker: Flora
response.text: Let me help you mark them on your map again.

talks.objective: Head to Dragonspine to retrieve the packages
Retrieve the package near the Dragonspine Statue of The Seven
Retrieve the package beside the body of water
Retrieve the package near the cavern

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: How are the flowers that we stored away on Dragonspine earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I only managed to retrieve one container...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: The others couldn't be retrieved? Um... Well, alright then. It is quite hard to predict conditions on that mountain, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: But if we only have one, then we can't make any comparisons. I suppose we'll just have to wait for another opportunity...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Thank you for taking the trouble, though. Here, I prepared these as compensation — I might need to call upon your help in the future as well.

talks.objective: Follow the trail to search for the package

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: How are the flowers that we stored away on Dragonspine earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have them all here.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: All of them? That's great! Here, let me see.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Hehe, not bad at all. Hmm... Looks like this method really does work.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: The only problem is that Dragonspine is really far from Mondstadt. I can't be troubling you every time, either. I have to find some other way in future...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, all the same. Here's your compensation, please take it!

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: How are the flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Eh? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I broke the containers and flowers by accident...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: B—By accident!?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Ugh... I specifically picked those flowers out. You can't find such good flowers just anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Is Dragonspine so dangerous that even an adventurer like you couldn't keep one container from...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Still, thanks for making that trip for me. Please take these as thanks. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to go tend to my flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I should try the method that Sara suggested after all...

talks.objective: Give the retrieved packages to Flora
Give the retrieved packages to Flora

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: How are the flowers that we stored away on Dragonspine earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I could only retrieve these.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Well, these experiments have produced good results. It seems as though preservation at low temperatures is a viable solution, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: The only problem is that Dragonspine is really far from Mondstadt. I can't be troubling you every time, either. I have to find some other way in future...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, all the same. Here's your compensation, please take it!
